description: This header defines functions, constants, and data structures for handling 5G NR band parameters, including ARFCN-to-frequency conversions, band validation, SSB parameter calculations, and CORESET configurations, primarily used by the MAC layer for scheduling and band management.

classes.name: ssb_coreset0_freq_location
classes.description: Data structure representing the frequency location parameters for CORESET0 and SSB, including offset, subcarrier offset, ARFCN, and indices.

methods.name: nr_band_to_uint
methods.description: Converts an nr_band enum to its corresponding uint16_t value.

methods.name: uint_to_nr_band
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to the corresponding nr_band enum.

methods.name: get_duplex_mode
methods.description: Returns the duplex mode (FDD/TDD) for a given NR band.

methods.name: get_band_from_dl_arfcn
methods.description: Returns the NR band that includes a given Downlink ARFCN.

methods.name: is_band_for_shared_spectrum
methods.description: Checks if a band is used for shared spectrum channel access.

methods.name: is_band_40mhz_min_ch_bw_equivalent
methods.description: Checks if a band should be considered as for 40MHz minimum channel bandwidth.

methods.name: is_ntn_band
methods.description: Checks if a band is an NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) band.

methods.name: is_dl_arfcn_valid_given_band
methods.description: Validates if a Downlink ARFCN is valid for a specific band.

methods.name: is_ul_arfcn_valid_given_band
methods.description: Validates if an Uplink ARFCN is valid for a specific band.

methods.name: get_ul_arfcn_from_dl_arfcn
methods.description: Returns the UL ARFCN corresponding to a given DL ARFCN and band.

methods.name: nr_arfcn_to_freq
methods.description: Converts an NR-ARFCN to its frequency in Hz.

methods.name: freq_to_nr_arfcn
methods.description: Calculates the NR-ARFCN from a given frequency in Hz.

methods.name: get_ssb_pattern
methods.description: Selects the SSB pattern case based on band and subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: get_ssb_ref_scs
methods.description: Gets the reference subcarrier spacing for SS/PBCH based on frequency range.

methods.name: get_most_suitable_ssb_scs
methods.description: Determines the most suitable SSB subcarrier spacing for a band.

methods.name: get_ssb_arfcn
methods.description: Calculates the ARFCN for an SSB given cell configuration parameters.

methods.name: is_ssb_arfcn_valid_given_band
methods.description: Validates if an SSB ARFCN is valid for a given band.

methods.name: get_abs_freq_point_a_from_f_ref
methods.description: Calculates the absolute frequency of Point A from a reference frequency.

methods.name: get_f_ref_from_abs_freq_point_a
methods.description: Calculates the RF reference frequency from the absolute frequency of Point A.

methods.name: get_n_rbs_from_bw
methods.description: Returns the number of resource blocks for a given bandwidth, SCS, and frequency range.

methods.name: get_min_channel_bw
methods.description: Returns the minimum channel bandwidth for a band and SCS.

methods.name: get_ssb_coreset0_freq_location
methods.description: Finds the CORESET0 frequency location parameters for a given configuration.

methods.name: get_ssb_coreset0_freq_location_for_cset0_idx
methods.description: Fetches CORESET0 frequency location parameters for specific CORESET0 and SSB indices.

methods.name: get_coreset0_index
methods.description: Searches for the CORESET0 index that maximizes non-intersecting RBs with SSB.

methods.name: get_nof_coreset0_rbs_not_intersecting_ssb
methods.description: Calculates the number of CORESET0 CRBs not intersecting with the SSB CRBs.

methods.name: get_ta_offset
methods.description: Returns the timing advance offset for a given band or frequency range.
